source: Contributor-extracted original audio; direct PCM analysis in current research session

method.channel_correlation: Pearson correlation of full left and right waveforms
method.spectral_energy: scipy.signal.stft, Hann window, nperseg 2048, noverlap 1024; center=(L+R)/2, sum magnitude-squared values for frequencies below 250 Hz divided by total

interpretation_limits: Whole-file spectral differences are not phoneme-specific.
Stereo decorrelation does not by itself identify a sound-processing technique.
A low-frequency energy concentration does not prove uvular/pharyngeal articulation, glottalization, or tonal language.
No independent IPA perceptual transcription obtained.
